H1_ORDERBOOK_IMBALANCE.statement: Order-book depth imbalance contains directional predictive information beyond OHLCV.
H1_ORDERBOOK_IMBALANCE.primary_metric: Spearman rank correlation with forward 1m/5m return

H2_TRADE_FLOW.statement: Aggressive buy/sell trade volume imbalance contains directional information beyond technical indicators.

H3_SPREAD_CONDITIONING.statement: Predictive signal quality and directional expectancy vary systematically as a function of bid-ask spread.
H3_SPREAD_CONDITIONING.primary_metric: Net return difference across spread quartiles

H4_LIQUIDITY_CONDITIONING.statement: Signal quality improves in high top-of-book depth regimes compared to thin market conditions.
H4_LIQUIDITY_CONDITIONING.primary_metric: Sharpe ratio differential between high vs low liquidity regimes

H5_FUNDING_RATE.statement: Perpetual swap funding rate and open interest contain incremental predictive information for spot/perp basis drift.
H5_FUNDING_RATE.primary_metric: 8-hour forward return predictability from funding skew

H6_EXECUTION_TIMING.statement: Execution quality (passive limit orders vs active taker orders) materially affects realized trading edge.
H6_EXECUTION_TIMING.primary_metric: Net P&L difference between maker vs taker execution

H7_HORIZON_SURVIVAL.statement: Any microstructure-derived signal retains predictive power beyond the immediate 1m–5m microstructure horizon.
H7_HORIZON_SURVIVAL.primary_metric: Decay half-life of directional accuracy across 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h

H8_ECONOMIC_VIABILITY.statement: At least one predictive signal clears realistic total execution friction (fees + spread + slippage + market impact + latency + safety margin) with statistically significant positive net expectancy.
H8_ECONOMIC_VIABILITY.primary_metric: Net expectancy per trade after total friction
H8_ECONOMIC_VIABILITY.alternative_hypothesis: Net_Expectancy > 0.0 bps with p < 0.05 after FDR correction
